create_chatbot_demo: create a gradio chatbot demo that lets users chat with Llama models via a web interface
run_chatbot_demo: run the gradio chatbot demo to interact with Llama 3 and Llama 3.1 models
load_model: load a Llama model and tokenizer from Hugging Face Hub for text generation
generate_chat: generate a chat response from a Llama model given user input and conversation history
launch_gradio_interface: launch a gradio Blocks interface with a chatbot, dropdown, and textbox for Llama model interaction
